Description: Functional-connectivity networks of one 2-minute interictal iEEG epoch (epoch 2 of 5) for MP0013, as released in files/MUSC/LR/result/MP0013_2.mat (byte-identical copy of the sourcedata file). MATLAB variables: 'results' and 'full_ind'.
ChannelSet: 'LR': subset for the seizure-onset-zone lateralisation analysis; left and right hemisphere networks of 36 standard mesial temporal contact slots

results.Notes: Measures computed in 2-s windows and averaged over the epoch; coherence, PLV and relative entropy per band; relative entropy taken in the direction of the higher value (Shi et al. 2024). Cells are NaN where a channel was not available for that re-referencing.

full_ind: MATLAB cell (1 x 2, one per re-referencing method): logical mask of the channels (gw) or of the 36 slots (LR) that carry values
SegmentWindowNote: Row n of patientList.time as released (start/stop of the epoch; units as in the authors' code, not stated in the release)
